sources.title: ブラックマトリクス ダブルオー 公式ガイド
sources.notes: PROVENANCE ONLY. Confirms a 175-page official guide exists and advertises coverage of all scenario battles/data, but page contents are not directly inspectable through the current research path.

disagreements: Research remains intentionally blocked before route generation. The scaffold now demonstrates the intended route-level optional-section model: mandatory chapter progression is split at the documented free-action windows, and each substantial bonus block is inserted inline as `【任意】` so the player never leaves the master order and returns later. Set A directly documents all 14 bonus-scenario windows/triggers. Set B independently corroborates mandatory battle order and broad ending/NG+ mechanics, but still does not independently enumerate all 14 bonus-scenario triggers and missable timing. The detailed FFSKY walkthrough agrees with those triggers but is Chinese and supplemental only. Do not generate route_*.json until a second directly inspectable Japanese source closes that remaining 100%-critical optional-content gap.
